info.title: Strategy Service API
info.description:
REST API for asynchronous strategy backtests, live strategy runs, and strategy discovery.

All endpoints except `/healthz` require `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.summary: Open a WebSocket connection for real-time lifecycle notifications
get.description: Upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket. The server authenticates using the standard Authorization header (ApiKey <key> or Bearer <token>), resolves the DORA user, and streams JSON-encoded Event objects as text frames. Clients that cannot set request headers may alternatively pass `x-api-key` as a query parameter; the header takes precedence when both are present. Optional query params: Last-Event-ID (UUIDv7) replays events from the log; types (comma-separated) filters by EventType. Heartbeat is WS-level ping/pong every 30s.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Replay events with id > Last-Event-ID (UUIDv7). Capped at 1000 events or 24h, whichever is smaller.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated whitelist of EventType values. Default: all.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Alternative to the Authorization header for clients that cannot set request headers on the WebSocket handshake. Ignored when the Authorization header is present.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive lower bound on created_at. Malformed values are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive upper bound on created_at. Malformed values are rejected with 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default 50, silently clamped to [1, 200].

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous call. Malformed values are rejected with 400.

get.summary: List the trading decisions recorded for a live strategy run, newest first
get.description: Returns the strategy_decisions rows for a single run owned by the authenticated user. Backtest runs are not represented in this table. The user is derived from the auth token, not the URL — wrong-user and not-found both produce 404. The cursor is opaque and versioned; do not parse it.

NotImplemented.description: Strategy is known but not implemented for the requested operation

Conflict.description: A strategy is already active for this order book

CopyTraderSummary.description: A single entry in the list-copy-traders response. The `id` is the DORA user id and matches the `followed_trader` field accepted by CopyTradingConfig. `user_name` is the DORA-registered handle surfaced for display in copy-trading run configuration UIs.

order_book_id.description: DORA order book UUID used to locate the traded asset and place orders.

initial_balance.description: Starting capital for backtests. Omitted for live runs — obtained from DORA positions.

BreakoutConfig.description: Volatility-compression / price-breakout strategy. Enters when short-window price volatility drops below a threshold of long-window volatility, then a close breaks above (or below) a k·ATR trigger band.

long_vol_window.description: Long-window price-volatility observation count. Must be greater than short_vol_window.

compression_threshold.description: ShortVol/LongVol ratio below which the strategy arms for a breakout.

atr_window.description: Rolling-mean window for ATR (mean absolute price diff).

breakout_atr_multiple.description: Number of ATR units above/below the most recent close that defines the breakout trigger band.

confirmation_bars.description: Number of consecutive closes beyond the trigger band required to fire.

stop_loss_atr.description: Stop-loss distance in ATR units. Mirrored in the live Run loop and the backtester.

take_profit_atr.description: Take-profit distance in ATR units from entry. Set to 0 to disable. Mirrored in the live Run loop and the backtester.

obv_window.description: Recent trades to include in windowed OBV (On-Balance Volume). 0 = no volume verification; > 0 verifies signals with the last N trades, sourced from the live trade stream (runs) or trades_history (backtests).

obv_trend_threshold.description: Absolute OBV threshold the breakout signal must clear when obv_window > 0. Direction-mapped.

min_long_vol_floor.description: Minimum LongVol required to trade. Suppresses entries on a completely flat baseline.

order_book_id.description: DORA order book UUID used to locate the traded asset and place orders.

initial_balance.description: Starting capital for backtests. Omitted for live runs — obtained from DORA positions.

MomentumConfig.description: Moving-average-crossover trend strategy with configurable signal source (price / ytm / spread) and entry-anchored ATR exits.

signal_source.description: Series the MA crossover runs on. `spread` requires `tenor`.

slow_window.description: Slow-MA tick window. Must be greater than fast_window.

stop_loss_atr.description: Stop-loss distance in ATR units. 0 disables.

take_profit_atr.description: Take-profit distance in ATR units. 0 disables.

min_order_size.description: Skip opening when the computed quantity is below this. 0 disables.

max_order_size.description: Clamp the order quantity down to this. 0 disables.

max_position_size.description: Maximum fraction of capital allocated per trade.

tenor.description: Benchmark Treasury tenor (e.g. 2Y, 5Y, 10Y). Required when signal_source is spread.

initial_balance.description: Starting capital. Must be greater than 0 for backtests; live runs may pass 0 to use the user's DORA USD balance.

followed_trader.description: DORA user id of the trader whose trades will be copied.

percentage_of_available.description: Fraction of available balance to allocate per copied trade. Must be in (0, 1].

leverage.description: Leverage multiplier applied to copied orders. Must be greater than 0.

min_order_size.description: Minimum order size; orders below this threshold are skipped. Defaults to 0.

max_order_size.description: Maximum order size; orders above this threshold are clipped. Must be >= min_order_size. Defaults to 0 (no cap).

disallowed_bonds.description: Bond UUIDs to exclude from copying. If absent or empty, all bonds are eligible.

initial_balance.description: Starting cash for backtests. Omit or set to 0 to use the package default (10000). Omitted for live runs — obtained from DORA positions.

error.description: Error message if the backtest failed

BacktestResultSummary.description: Flattened backtest result returned by GET /v1/backtests/{id}. Mirrors the Go BacktestResultSummary struct — contains result fields at top level alongside strategy type, status, and config, but omits id, dora_user_id, and timestamps.

error.description: Error message if the backtest failed

MomentumTradeRecord.description: Momentum trade row emitted by GET /v1/backtests/{id}/trades for momentum backtests.

fast_ma.description: Fast MA at the decision. Not persisted (no backing column); always empty on rows read back from this endpoint.

slow_ma.description: Slow MA at the decision. Not persisted (no backing column); always empty on rows read back from this endpoint.

entry_atr.description: ATR captured on the opening row; mirrored onto the matching exit row.

MomentumClosedTrade.description: Momentum closed-trade row emitted by GET /v1/backtests/{id}/closed-trades for momentum backtests.

pnl.description: Profit/loss in price terms: quantity x (exit_price - entry_price), signed by direction.

exit_reason.description: One of stop_loss, take_profit, reversal, strategy_exit.

BreakoutTradeRecord.description: Breakout trade row emitted by GET /v1/backtests/{id}/trades for breakout backtests.

compression_ratio.description: Short-window / long-window volatility ratio at the tick that armed the breakout (armed ratio on entry rows).

entry_atr.description: ATR captured on the opening row; mirrored onto the matching exit row.

BreakoutClosedTrade.description: Breakout closed-trade row emitted by GET /v1/backtests/{id}/closed-trades for breakout backtests.

pnl.description: Profit/loss in price terms: quantity x (exit_price - entry_price), signed by direction.

exit_reason.description: One of stop_loss, take_profit, reversal, strategy_exit.

entry_compression_ratio.description: Compression ratio at the entry tick (short/long window volatility).

exit_compression_ratio.description: Compression ratio at the exit tick.

Event.description: A single notification event delivered over the WebSocket. New event types (notably dora.*) may appear without a spec change — clients MUST tolerate unknown values of `type`.

id.description: UUIDv7. Monotonic; used as the Last-Event-ID replay cursor.

user_id.description: DORA user id the event belongs to.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in RFC3339, always UTC.

NotificationLogEntry.description: Internal. Persisted copy of an Event used for Last-Event-ID replay. Not exposed via the REST API.

Decision.description: One trading decision recorded during a live strategy run. The row is the source of truth for the inputs that produced a single market order; clients should treat all fields as immutable audit data.

DecisionList.description: One page of trading decisions. next_cursor is omitted on the last page; clients should treat absent and empty string the same.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Pass back as the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page. Clients MUST NOT parse this value.
